lumilib.title: LumiLib
lumilib.summary: Shared foundation and hub for Lumitier's mods.
lumilib.hub.title: LumiLib
lumilib.option.show_session.desc: Show your skin head and account name at the top of the hub. Turn it off if you stream or record and would rather not have your account name on screen. LumiLib never displays or stores your session token either way.
lumilib.entry.present: Installed, but not connected to LumiLib.
lumilib.mod.not_linked: This version does not register with LumiLib. Its settings are available through Mod Menu.
lumilib.option.show_missing.desc: List mods that are not installed, greyed out and with a link. Turn it off to see only what is actually running.
lumilib.option.menu_button.desc: Show a LumiLib button in the title screen and the pause menu. Takes effect the next time the menu opens.
lumilib.option.language.desc: Language for LumiLib and the mods built on it. The rest of Minecraft keeps the language set in Options.
lumilib.option.dark_theme.desc: The dark palette. Off brings back the light glass LumiLib started with. Switching rebuilds the shaders once, so the first frame after may stutter.
lumilib.option.hub_sound_volume.desc: Volume of the quiet pad that plays while the hub is open, and of the opening and closing sounds. 0 turns all three off. Scales with Minecraft's UI volume slider on top of this.
lumilib.option.open_mod_menu.desc: Every mod on this instance, not just these.
lumilib.server.disabled: Disabled by this server. Your settings are kept and apply again when you leave.
lumilib.picker.title: Choose an item
lumilib.enchant.title: Choose an enchantment
lumilib.option.animations.desc: Let the hub fade in and out, slide between pages and ease hover and switches. Turn it off for hard cuts.
lumilib.updates.title: Updates
lumilib.updates.source: Mod Menu checks for new versions when the game starts.
lumilib.updates.installed_only: Installed %s, a newer version is available
lumilib.preview.no_world: Join a world to see the preview
lumilib.players.title: Add a player
lumilib.players.empty: Nobody else is online. Type a name to add someone.
